title_zh: 江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋接受审查调查
title_en: Liu Jianyang, Standing Committee Member and Organization Department Head of Jiangsu Provincial Committee, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月31日消息，江苏省委常委、组织部部长刘建洋涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection announced on August 31 that Liu Jianyang, Standing Committee member and head of the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
